terms.conditions: The official FAQ directs customers to redeem a valid code in the customer portal's Gift Code section. A linked valid credit card or PayPal is required for promotion eligibility. This page records public official listings; it is not a completed redemption or account-eligibility test.

The match FAQ says the promotional match credit expires 12 months after issuance. Usage is paid 50/50 from promotional credit and real funds. Existing customers and duplicate accounts are not eligible. These match-specific rules are not assigned to the other codes.

terms.offer: Other credit expiries and campaign cutoff
terms.conditions: The general FAQ says promo credits expire. The $200, $250 and $300 landing pages checked did not publish a specific credit lifetime; no calendar campaign cutoff was published in the checked coupons listing. The match page says its offer is limited-time without giving a calendar deadline. An unpublished date does not mean permanent validity.

terms.offer: Hourly charges and minimum billing unit
terms.conditions: The official FAQ says servers are billed hourly, with a minimum billing unit of one hour, and accumulated charges are invoiced on the first of each month. Billing caps depend on product category; a promotional credit does not make every deployed resource free indefinitely.

terms.offer: Stopping an instance does not end its charges
terms.conditions: Stopped instances continue to reserve resources and remain billable until destroyed. The official FAQ instructs customers to use DESTROY in the customer portal to stop accumulating charges for that virtual machine. This is a billing explanation; no resources were created or destroyed for this page.

terms.offer: Taxes are excluded from listed prices
terms.conditions: Vultr says it collects applicable VAT, consumption tax or sales tax in several countries. Listed website prices exclude tax; tax is added separately on the invoice.

The official FAQ says Vultr does not offer refunds. The Terms also limit refunds of prepaid fees and rule out prorated subscription refunds, subject to applicable law. Do not treat a deposit or promotional credit as a refundable cash balance.
